title: The She-Camel Sign and a Proud People

paragraphs.text: The messenger told his people again to fear Allah and obey him. He made it clear that he wanted no payment from them, because his reward comes only from the Lord of the worlds. Then he asked them a question to make them think. Did they believe they would be left secure forever in what they had? They lived among gardens and springs, with fields of crops and palm trees whose fruit was soft and ripe. They also carved homes out of the mountains with great skill. Although they had all these blessings, they did not turn to their Lord. So he called them once more to fear Allah and follow him. He warned them not to obey the orders of the transgressors, who spread corruption in the land and never try to set things right.

The people did not accept his message. They said that he was only someone under the effect of magic. They also said he was just a man like them, so he should bring a sign if he was truly honest. He answered by showing them a she-camel. She would have her own time to drink, and they would have theirs, each on a known day. He warned them not to touch her with any harm, because then the punishment of a terrible day would take them. But they wounded her legs, and afterwards they became regretful. Then the punishment seized them. This story is a clear sign, although most of them were not believers. Truly, the Lord is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
After this, a new story begins. The people of Lot also denied the messengers, which shows that they followed the same path as the nations who came before them.
